text: This staff report is about a matter which Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. Transportation Services has assessed an appeal from the owner of 87 Hanna Road for front yard parking. Front yard parking at this location is not recommended because it does not meet the polling requirements of the City of Toronto Municipal Code Chapter 918 in that the poll result was negative. The owner will be given an opportunity to make a deputation before Community Council.
North York Community Council: 1. Denied the request for front yard parking at 87 Hanna Road.
